title: Switch the Narration Voice, See the Real Cost | vitalii.no
description:
The explainer pipeline ran on one hardcoded narration voice, and changing it meant shipping new code. Worse, nobody could see what any single video actually cost — only a lump total at the end of the month.

An admin card now switches the narration voice per language with no deploy. Every render tries a primary text-to-speech engine first and falls back automatically if a call fails, logging exactly which engine spoke each line.

Each video's real cost — AI time, voice generation, and render minutes — is now added up and stored per video, combining all three into one number an admin can actually see instead of guessing from the monthly bill.
